verdict.rationale: First-party docs have a dedicated SDK section described as "Official SDKs for integrating Hyperbrowser into your applications." The introduction offers "our SDKs" as an alternative to Puppeteer/Playwright, and the sandbox install docs point users to the SDKs, with an SDK code example (sandbox.exec). Missing for 10: which languages the SDKs cover, any depth of SDK reference documentation in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration such as SDK GitHub repos or community usage reports.
